# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: South Korea1970 national programme.
# Generated by tools/COLDWAR_KOR_1970_concept/COLDWAR_KOR_runtime.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = KOR }
				KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_initialize = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly_KOR = {
		effect = { COLDWAR_KOR_weekly = yes }
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { tag = KOR IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_initialized }
					}
					COLDWAR_KOR_initialize = yes
				}
				COLDWAR_KOR_politics_daily = yes
				COLDWAR_KOR_contract_maintenance = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes }
				COLDWAR_KOR_sync_politics = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes }
				COLDWAR_KOR_sync_politics = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			COLDWAR_KOR_foreign_refresh = yes
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = KOR }
				KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_foreign_refresh = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
